editorial:
You follow Eddie Brock, a reporter whose life falls apart after he digs into a powerful company. When an alien symbiote bonds with him, he gains wild powers and a voice in his head. The movie mixes superhero action with buddy comedy, giving you big fights, loud humor, and a messy but fun ride through San Francisco streets and labs.

Tom Hardy makes Eddie and Venom entertaining, especially their arguments and strange teamwork. Action scenes are energetic, though some effects look rough and the villain is plain. The story moves quickly, so you rarely feel bored. It is not deep, but it is fast and silly in a good way. If you want serious comic book drama, skip it. If you want popcorn fun, watch it. Stream in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Eddie and Venom fight Carlton Drake and Riot at the launch site. Venom destroys the rocket and seemingly dies, but Eddie survives. Later, Eddie returns to work and Venom is still inside him, ready for more trouble. A post-credits scene teases Carnage, hinting at a bigger threat. You also see a quick tease of another dangerous symbiote.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves loud superhero action and buddy comedy.
